what: On hover over performer names · ticket links · share buttons, a lime→sky 150° gradient plate appears and that plate cycles through the color wheel once in 2s and back, repeatedly (filter: hue-rotate, CSS default ease · alternate) — the sparkling selection mark of a neon event page. With look: always it spins constantly without hover (strip · badge).

options.--fx-grad: Panel gradient (css variable), default lime→sky rotated from the accent color
options.--fx-dur: Length of one rotation (css variable), default 2s
options.look: If always, it runs constantly without interaction

note: filter spins the panel’s text too (the original does as well) — to keep the text color, place the text as a sibling outside the panel
